title: Model connection settings
description: Choose a provider and model. Each provider keeps its own connection settings.
modelPlaceholder: Enter the model ID your provider gives you
baseUrlConfigured: URL is set. Leave blank to keep it
baseUrlDefault: Leave blank to use the provider's default URL
apiKeyConfigured: Key is set. Leave blank to keep it
apiKeyPlaceholder: Enter the key for this provider
storageNote: The key and custom URL are kept only in the memory of this backend process. Leave blank to keep existing settings.
modelRequired: Enter a model ID before saving the connection settings.
keyMissing: No API key is configured for this provider. Enter one before running a real model.
keyNotRequired: This service needs no API key. Leave it blank.
